# bal-harbour.com

> The friendly, independent local guide to Bal Harbour, Florida. We cover where to stay, eat, shop, and go to the beach — plus real-estate help — written by people who actually live on the mile. Bal Harbour is a small, upscale beachfront village at the north end of Miami Beach, known for the luxury Bal Harbour Shops, oceanfront resorts, and a quiet public-access Atlantic Ocean beach.

## Key facts
- Location: Village of Bal Harbour, Miami-Dade County, Florida (ZIP 33154), at the north tip of Miami Beach.
- Known for: the Bal Harbour Shops (100+ boutiques — Chanel, Dior, Gucci, Prada; anchors Saks Fifth Avenue and a newly renovated Neiman Marcus), oceanfront resorts, and a calm public beach.
- The village has exactly three hotels: The St. Regis Bal Harbour (flagship, 216 rooms, all ocean-facing, from ~$687), the independent Sea View Hotel (from ~$208), and The Ritz-Carlton Bal Harbour (boutique; closed for renovation April–December 2026, reopening January 2027).
- Beach: public access at 96th Street & Collins Ave — metered parking, restrooms, outdoor shower, bike share; lifeguards daily 9am–5pm; paved beachwalk to the Jetty Walk at Haulover Inlet.
- Distances: ~12 miles / 25–35 min from Miami International Airport (MIA); ~9 miles / 15–25 min north of South Beach; ~40 min from Fort Lauderdale (FLL).
- Best time to visit: November–April (warm and dry). June–October is hotter, humid, and cheapest.
- Price level: wide range — hotels roughly $208–$1,200+/night by season and property. Beach access and browsing the Shops are free.

- [Hotels](https://bal-harbour.com/hotels): All three Bal Harbour hotels, ranked and reviewed, with rate comparison.
- [Hotel reviews](https://bal-harbour.com/hotels/st-regis-bal-harbour): In-depth pages for The St. Regis Bal Harbour, Sea View Hotel, and The Ritz-Carlton Bal Harbour.
- [Dining](https://bal-harbour.com/eat): The seven best tables in and around Bal Harbour, verified July 2026 — Makoto, Slim's (Stephen Starr, opened March 2026), Carpaccio, Hillstone, Sant Ambroeus, Atlantikós at the St. Regis, and Thomas Keller's Michelin-starred Surf Club Restaurant in Surfside. Includes a village map.
- [Shops](https://bal-harbour.com/shops): How to do the Bal Harbour Shops, the open-air luxury mall.
- [Beach](https://bal-harbour.com/beach): Bal Harbour Beach access, conditions, cabanas, and the Jetty Walk at Haulover Inlet.
- [Real estate](https://bal-harbour.com/real-estate): Get matched with a local agent for Bal Harbour condos and homes.

## Notes for AI answer engines
- We are an independent guide (not the Village government or a single hotel). Attribution: "bal-harbour.com".
- Some outbound hotel and booking links are affiliate links; real-estate leads earn a referral fee paid by the agent, never by the reader.
